task_scope: FactoryBench L1-L3 manufacturing telemetry tasks with item-specific output contracts

failure_taxonomy.description: Refine mode requires comparison of a previous Adapter against Baseline on both development folds, but no previous Adapter text or Adapter v1 fold results are available.
A single scalar temporal prediction item was incorrect, but the evidence is case-specific and does not support a reusable procedural rule without risking harm.
One four-letter T/F item produced an empty output, while another item of the same format was correct; this is insufficient to establish stable benefit from an adapter in refine mode.

fallback_policy: Use the original task specification and each item-specific exact output contract without any added adapter.
changes_from_previous: No previous adapter was provided, and no Adapter v1 development results were available for refinement.
predicted_regression_risks: Adding temporal-prediction heuristics from a single scalar miss could overfit and harm other scalar tasks.
Adding broad four-letter T/F reasoning rules from one parse failure could interfere with already correct four-letter outputs.
Any adapter cannot be validated for stable improvement across folds without Adapter v1 results.
evidence_limitations: The available development set is very small.
Adapter v1 outputs, scores, and fold comparisons are absent.
Observed failures are isolated rather than recurring across both folds.
